Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الْأَعْظَمِ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your Great, Greatest Name
The Most Mighty, Most Glorious, Most Generous

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى مَغَالِقِ أَبْوَابِ السَّمَاءِ لِلْفَتْحِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ انْفَتَحَتْ
Translation: Which when You are called upon by it to open the locked gates of heaven for mercy, they open

Arabic text: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى مَضَائِقِ أَبْوَابِ الْأَرْضِ لِلْفَرَجِ انْفَرَجَتْ
Translation: And when You are called upon by it to relieve the constrictions of earth, they are relieved

Arabic text: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى الْعُسْرِ لِلْيُسْرِ تَيَسَّرَتْ
Translation: And when You are called upon by it to ease difficulties, they become easy

Arabic text: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى الْأَمْوَاتِ لِلنُّشُورِ انْتَشَرَتْ
Translation: And when You are called upon by it to resurrect the dead, they are raised

Arabic text: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى كَشْفِ الْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ انْكَشَفَتْ
Translation: And when You are called upon by it to remove hardship and affliction, they are removed
And by the majesty of Your Generous Face
The Most Generous and Most Mighty of all faces
To which all faces humble themselves
And before which all necks bow
And before which all voices are hushed
And before which all hearts tremble out of fear of You
And by Your power by which

Arabic text: تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِكَ
Translation: You hold the sky from falling onto the earth except by Your permission
And You hold the heavens and earth from moving away
And by Your will to which all worlds submit

Arabic text: وَبِكَلِمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ خَلَقْتَ بِهَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
Translation: And by Your word by which You created the heavens and the earth
And by Your wisdom with which You created wonders
And created darkness and made it night
And made the night a time of rest
And created light and made it day
And made the day a time of awakening and visibility

Arabic text: وَخَلَقْتَ بِهَا الشَّمْسَ وَجَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً
Translation: And created the sun and made the sun radiant

Arabic text: وَخَلَقْتَ بِهَا الْقَمَرَ وَجَعَلْتَ الْقَمَرَ نُورًا
Translation: And created the moon and made the moon a light
And created the stars

Arabic text: وَجَعَلْتَهَا نُجُومًا وَبُرُوجًا وَمَصَابِيحَ وَزِينةً وَرُجُومًا
Translation: And made them stars, constellations, lamps, adornment, and missiles
And assigned them rising and setting places
And assigned them places of ascent and courses
And assigned them orbits and paths

Arabic text: وَقَدَّرْتَهَا فِيْ السَّمَاءِ مَنَازِلَ فَأَحْسَنْتَ تَقْدِيرَهَا
Translation: And ordained for them stations in the sky, arranging them excellently
And formed them, giving them excellent form
And enumerated them by Your names completely
And managed them with Your wisdom excellently
And subjected them to the authority of night and the authority of day
And hours and count of years and calculation

Arabic text: وَجَعَلْتَ رُؤْيَتَهَا لِجَمِيعِ النَّاسِ مَرْئً وَاحِدًا
Translation: And made their appearance to all people appear as one
And I ask You, O Allah, by Your glory

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ كَلَّمْتَ بِهِ عَبْدَكَ وَرَسُولَكَ مُوْسَى بْنَ عِمْرَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِيْ الْمُقَدَّسِينَ
Translation: With which You spoke to Your servant and messenger Moses son of Imran, peace be upon him, among the sanctified ones
Above the perception of the Cherubim
Above the clouds of light
Above the Ark of the Covenant

Arabic text: فِيْ عَمُودِ النَّارِ وَفِيْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ
Translation: In the pillar of fire and on Mount Sinai
And on Mount Horeb
In the sacred valley
In the blessed spot

Arabic text: مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ
Translation: From the right side of the Mount, from the tree

Arabic text: وَفِيْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ بِتِسْعِ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ
Translation: And in the land of Egypt with nine clear signs
And on the day You parted the sea for the Children of Israel

Arabic text: وَفِيْ الْمُنْبَجِسَاتِ الَّتِيْ صَنَعْتَ بِهَا الْعَجَائِبَ فِيْ بَحْرِ سُوفٍ
Translation: And in the gushing springs with which You created wonders in the Red Sea

Arabic text: وَعَقَدْتَ مَاءَ الْبَحْرِ فِيْ قَلْبِ الْغَمْرِ كَالْحِجَارَةِ
Translation: And You held the waters of the sea in the heart of the deep like stones
And You led the Children of Israel across the sea

Arabic text: وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُكَ الْحُسْنىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا
Translation: And Your good word was fulfilled for them for their patience

Arabic text: وَأَوْرَثْتَهُمْ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا الَّتِيْ بَارَكْتَ فِيهَا لِلْعَالَمِينَ
Translation: And You made them inherit the eastern and western parts of the land which You blessed for all people

Arabic text: وَأَغْرَقْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجُنُودَهُ وَمَرَاكِبَهُ فِيْ الْيَمِّ
Translation: And You drowned Pharaoh and his soldiers and his chariots in the sea
And by Your Great, Greatest Name
The Most Mighty, Most Glorious, Most Generous

Arabic text: وَبِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِيْ تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِمُوسىٰ كَلِيمِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِيْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ
Translation: And by Your glory with which You manifested to Moses, Your interlocutor, peace be upon him, on Mount Sinai

Arabic text: وَلِإِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ خَلِيلِكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فِيْ مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ
Translation: And to Abraham, peace be upon him, Your friend before, in the Mosque of Al-Khayf

Arabic text: وَلِإِسْحَاقَ صَفِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِيْ بِئْرِ شِيَعٍ
Translation: And to Isaac, Your chosen one, peace be upon him, at the Well of Sheba

Arabic text: وَلِيَعْقُوبَ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِيْ بَيْتِ إِيلٍ
Translation: And to Jacob, Your prophet, peace be upon him, in Bethel
And You fulfilled for Abraham, peace be upon him, Your covenant
And for Isaac Your oath
And for Jacob Your testimony
And for the believers Your promise
And for those who call upon Your names, and You answered

Arabic text: وَبِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِيْ ظَهَرَ لِمُوْسَى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَلَى قُبَّةِ الرُّمَّانِ
Translation: And by Your glory which appeared to Moses son of Imran, peace be upon him, on the Dome of Pomegranates

Arabic text: وَبِآيَاتِكَ الَّتِيْ وَقَعَتْ عَلَى أَرْضِ مِصْرَ
Translation: And by Your signs which fell upon the land of Egypt
By the glory of might and triumph
With mighty signs
And by the authority of power
And by the might of ability
And by the grandeur of the perfect word

Arabic text: وَبِكَلِمَاتِكَ الَّتِيْ تَفَضَّلْتَ بِهَا عَلَى أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
Translation: And by Your words with which You favored the inhabitants of the heavens and earth
And the people of this world and the people of the hereafter

Arabic text: وَبِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ مَنَنْتَ بِهَا عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And by Your mercy which You bestowed upon all Your creation

Arabic text: وَبِاسْتِطَاعَتِكَ الَّتِيْ أَقَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
Translation: And by Your power which You established over all worlds

Arabic text: وَبِنُوْرِكَ الَّذِيْ قَدْ خَرَّ مِنْ فَزَعِهِ طُورُ سَيْنَاءَ
Translation: And by Your light from the fear of which Mount Sinai collapsed
And by Your knowledge, Your majesty, Your greatness, and Your might
And Your omnipotence which the earth cannot bear
And before which the heavens bow down
And the greatest depth is restrained by it
And the seas and rivers become still by it
And the mountains submit to it
And the earth with its regions rests by it
And all creatures surrender to it
And the winds flutter in their flowing by it
And fires are extinguished in their places by it

Arabic text: وَبِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِيْ عُرِفَتْ لَكَ بِهِ الْغَلَبَةُ دَهْرَ الدُّهُورِ
Translation: And by Your authority by which Your supremacy is known throughout all ages
And You are praised by it in the heavens and earths

Arabic text: وَبِكَلِمَتِكَ كَلِمَةِ الصِّدْقِ الَّتِيْ سَبَقَتْ لِأَبِينَا آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ
Translation: And by Your word, the word of truth, which preceded for our father Adam, peace be upon him, and his progeny with mercy

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَلِمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ غَلَبَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
Translation: And I ask You by Your word which overcame everything

Arabic text: وَبِنُوْرِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِيْ تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِلْجَبَلِ
Translation: And by the light of Your face with which You manifested to the mountain
And made it crumble, and Moses fell unconscious

Arabic text: وَبِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِيْ ظَهَرَ عَلَى طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ
Translation: And by Your glory which appeared on Mount Sinai

Arabic text: فَكَلَّمْتَ بِهِ عَبْدَكَ وَرَسُولَكَ مُوْسَى بْنَ عِمْرَانَ
Translation: With which You spoke to Your servant and messenger Moses son of Imran
And by Your appearance in Seir

Arabic text: وَظُهُورِكَ فِيْ جَبَلِ فَارَانَ بِرَبَوَاتِ الْمُقَدَّسِينَ
Translation: And Your manifestation on Mount Paran with tens of thousands of holy ones
And armies of angels in ranks
And the humility of the glorifying angels

Arabic text: وَبِبَرَكَاتِكَ الَّتِيْ بَارَكْتَ فِيهَا عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
Translation: And by Your blessings with which You blessed Abraham, Your friend, peace be upon him

Arabic text: فِيْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: In the nation of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family
And You blessed Isaac, Your chosen one
In the nation of Jesus, peace be upon them
And You blessed Jacob, Your Israel
In the nation of Moses, peace be upon them

Arabic text: وَبَارَكْتَ لِحَبِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And You blessed Your beloved Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family
In his progeny, his descendants, and his nation

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَكَمَا غِبْنَا عَنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَمْ نَشْهَدْهُ وَ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَمْ نَرَهُ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا
Translation: O Allah, as we were absent from that and did not witness it, yet believed in it without seeing it, in truth and justice

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تُبَارِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And that You bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَتَرَحَّمَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And have mercy upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
Translation: As the best of what You blessed, sanctified, and had mercy upon Abraham and the family of Abraham
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious
Doer of whatever You intend
And You have power over all things
O Allah, by the right of this supplication
And by the right of these names
Whose interpretation no one knows
And whose inner meanings no one knows except You

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And treat me as You are worthy of doing

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِيْ مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
Translation: And do not treat me as I deserve

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِيْ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ
Translation: And forgive my sins, past and future
And expand for me from Your lawful provision
And protect me from the burden of evil people
And evil neighbors
And evil companions
And evil rulers
Indeed, You have power over whatever You will
And You are knowledgeable of all things
Amen, O Lord of the worlds
O Allah, by the right of this supplication
And by the right of these names

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ لَا يَعْلَمُ تَفْسِيرَهَا وَلَا تَأْوِيلَهَا
Translation: Whose interpretation and inner meaning no one knows

Arabic text: وَلَا يَعْلَمُ بَاطِنَهَا وَلَا ظَاهِرَهَا غَيْرُكَ
Translation: And whose inner and outer aspects no one knows except You

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And that You grant me the good of this world and the hereafter
And treat me as You are worthy of doing

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِيْ مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
Translation: And do not treat me as I deserve
And take revenge for me against [so-and-so]

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِيْ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْهَا وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ
Translation: And forgive my sins, past and future
And for my parents and all the believing men and women
And expand for me from Your lawful provision
And protect me from the burden of evil people
And evil neighbors
And evil rulers
And evil companions
And evil days
And evil hours
And take revenge for me against those who plot against me
And against those who oppress me
And intend harm for me and my family
And my children and my brothers
And my neighbors and my relatives
From among the believing men and women, unjustly
Indeed, You have power over whatever You will
And You are knowledgeable of all things
Amen, O Lord of the worlds
O Allah, by the right of this supplication

Arabic text: تَفَضَّلْ عَلَى فُقَرَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالْغِنىٰ وَالثَّرْوَةِ
Translation: Bestow upon the poor among the believing men and women wealth and prosperity

Arabic text: وَعَلىٰ مَرْضَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالشِّفَاءِ وَالصِّحَّةِ
Translation: And upon the sick among the believing men and women healing and health

Arabic text: وَعَلىٰ أَحْيَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِاللُّطْفِ وَالْكَرَامَةِ
Translation: And upon the living among the believing men and women kindness and honor

Arabic text: وَعَلىٰ أَمْوَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ
Translation: And upon the deceased among the believing men and women forgiveness and mercy

Arabic text: وَعَلىٰ مُسَافِرِيْ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِالرَّدِّ إِلَى أَوْطَانِهِمْ سَالِمِينَ غَانِمِينَ
Translation: And upon the travelers among the believing men and women safe return to their homelands, safe and successful
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَعِتْرَتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
Translation: And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets, and his pure progeny
And grant them abundant peace
